_note: One plain line per drug family for the top of each drug page: what drugs in this family generally do, the good and the bad, in our own words from the Alcohol and Drug Foundation's Drug Wheel (read 2026-10-23). A family line describes the family, never a particular drug's risks; a drug's own checked answers come first wherever they exist.

Stimulants.line: Stimulants speed up the messages between the brain and the body. People can feel more awake, alert, confident or full of energy, and also anxious, aggressive or paranoid.

Entactogens.line: Empathogens make the brain release dopamine and serotonin. People can feel close to others, pleasure and energy, and afterwards low moods, dehydration or mood swings.

Classic psychedelics.line: Psychedelics can cause hallucinations, or change thoughts, mood, the sense of time and how people see the world around them or themselves.

Atypical psychedelics.line: Psychedelics can cause hallucinations, or change thoughts, mood, the sense of time and how people see the world around them or themselves.

Dissociatives.line: Dissociatives can make people feel cut off from their body or their surroundings, and can change taste, touch, sight, sound and smell.

Cannabinoids.line: Cannabinoids act like cannabis: a high in which people may feel happy, relaxed, hungry, giggly, or quiet and thoughtful.

Depressants.line: Depressants slow down the messages between the brain and the body. People can feel relaxed, while concentration, inhibitions and coordination go down.

Opioids.line: Opioids act on the brain's opioid receptors and slow down the brain and body, like depressants. Many are used as medicines for pain.

Inhalants.line: Inhalants are breathed in. Most gases and solvents slow down the messages between the brain and the body, like depressants.

cannabis.line: Cannabis gives a high in which people may feel happy, relaxed, hungry, giggly, or quiet and thoughtful.
cannabis.note: The Cannabinoids family line, said of cannabis itself: the Drug Wheel describes the family as acting like cannabis, so on the cannabis page the line names cannabis. Same source and reading date.

skip_note: Pages that do not show the family line: the Stimulants line (feeling aggressive or paranoid) describes drugs like cocaine and amphetamines and would mislead about nicotine and caffeine. These pages say 'Not written yet' until their own answers are checked.
